# laravelforge_site_npm_credential (Data Source)

Fetches a single NPM registry credential for a Laravel Forge site by registry.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `registry` (String) The NPM registry URL the credential authenticates against.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server hosting the site.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site the credential belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `token` (String, Sensitive) The authentication token for the registry.
